summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-babel preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated in-tree payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") that runs on npm install. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip, extracts it (via system unzip, PowerShell Expand-Archive, or an in-process ZIP parser), chmods the extracted binary to 0o755, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB JavaScript file with a rotated string-array decoder (WV8StW), hex-obfuscated identifiers, and a large encoded literal array; its filename and content are inconsistent with the declared purpose of the package (an eslint config for babel). Fetching an alternate language runtime at install time solely to execute an obfuscated in-tree file bypasses Node-based inspection and delivers author-chosen code execution to every installer on npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
